description: Agent Action Capsule (verdict_class=denied) — worked example for permissionless anchoring of a capsule content-address.
provenance: Self-constructed to conform to the format of the individual Internet-Draft draft-mih-scitt-agent-action-capsule-02. NOT produced by Action State Group, Steven Mih, or SCITT tooling. Not a WG document. Demonstrates permissionless anchoring of a capsule content-address, not adoption.
digest_construction: capsule_id = HEX(SHA-256(JCS(normalize(envelope minus capsule_id and chain)))) per spec Section 5.1
